cpp_sampled_status.note: Validates the EndingScheme list with Cutkosky enabled. The tt kinematics (s=30, t=-10/3, msq=1) is below the Cutkosky threshold for the boundary integrals encountered, so Tradition fires throughout — this confirms the Cutkosky entry in the priority list does not perturb numerics when not invoked. The top integral matches both the tt baseline (tt_2loop_box_eps001_mma_reference.json) and this Cutkosky-enabled run, demonstrating EndingScheme is purely a recursion-strategy switch. C++ wallclock floor is set by the chosen arb output precision; comparing with --rel-tol 1e-15 reflects the printed-interval width, not the underlying numeric agreement.
